subject: European residency pricing breakout and commitment discounts
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medtech-eu.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marco Bianchi <marco.b@medtech-eu.com>, Procurement <procurement@medtech-eu.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T08:12:00+02:00
Subject: Quick: EU residency adder + baseline hosted pricing

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the intro call last week. As we start to build the internal business case I need two quick things to share with procurement this morning: a clear baseline for Redwood hosted API pricing (per 1k tokens or per-request equivalent) and the delta (data residency adder) we would expect for EU-hosted logs/data residency (we are evaluating a full EU-only control plane).

Context:
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~40M tokens/day (burst to 120M/day occasionally) with avg generation lengths of 180 tokens.
- Use case: inference + embeddings for patient-facing insights (PHI under pseudonymization).
- Timeline: pilot in Q4, production by Q1 2027.

Specific asks:
1) Baseline hosted API list price (US region) for generation and embeddings, with common bundle examples (monthly volumes 1M / 10M / 50M / 200M tokens).
2) Typical residency adder for EU-only storage/processing and any recurring fees (per GB or % uplift).
3) Commitment/term discount examples (12/24/36 months).
4) Security/compliance note: are logs and audit trails guaranteed to remain in-region if we choose EU residency? Encryption at rest and in transit?

Can you send a short written breakdown + an attached rate card we can circulate? Procurement has a 10am CET sync tomorrow so even a concise sheet would help.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform Operations
MedTech Europe
+39 345 678 910

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marco Bianchi <marco.b@medtech-eu.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T11:04:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Quick: EU residency adder + baseline hosted pricing

Hi Elena,

Appreciate the context — sending a concise breakdown below and attaching our curated rate card for Q4 (Redwood_Hosted_Rate_Card_v2.xlsx). High level answers first, then a short note on residency.

Baseline (US hosted API) — list (per 1k tokens):
- Prompt tokens: $0.80 / 1k tokens
- Completion tokens: $1.60 / 1k tokens
- Embeddings: $0.45 / 1k tokens

Volume examples (monthly):
- 1M tokens: ~ $800 - $1.600 (depending split prompt/completion)
- 10M tokens: $8k - $16k
- 50M tokens: $40k - $80k
- 200M tokens: $160k - $320k

EU residency adder (hosted):
- Typical uplift for EU-only logs + regional processing: +10% on unit pricing.
- Optional dedicated log retention in-region (longer retention windows) is available as an add-on at $0.02 / GB / month.

Commitment discounts (applied to list before residency adder):
- 12-month commit: 10% off list
- 24-month commit: 14% off list
- 36-month commit: 18% off list + one month of service credit upon signing

Security/compliance:
- We can guarantee that customer-requested logs and audit trails marked ‘EU-only’ are stored in EU regions when the EU residency option is enabled.
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest. We support customer-managed keys via KMS for Private deployments; hosted supports dedicated KMS per account for enterprise plans.

Notes:
- The residency adder assumes shared-hosted infrastructure in EU region pools. If you need fully dedicated hardware in-region (physical isolation), we can provide pricing but that typically shifts the model to a Dedicated contract.
- I attached the rate card (sheet contains per-1k breakdown, summary bundles, and sample invoice math for the volumes you sent).

If you like, I can join procurement's 10am CET call tomorrow to walk through the sheet.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: Redwood_Hosted_Rate_Card_v2.xlsx)

Hi Monica,

Thanks — the sheet is helpful. A couple follow-ups from procurement and legal:
- They asked if the 10% residency adder is negotiable for committed spend. Our target for year 1 production would be ~120M tokens/month.
- Procurement is pushing for a 36-month commitment. Would you be able to reach 15% off list for a 36-month committed contract at that volume?
- Also need confirmation that (1) logs marked EU-only will not be egressed to US-based systems for analytics, (2) whether rate-limits or bursting policies differ by region.

Appreciate a short note so we can move to draft SOW.

Best,
Elena

Subject: Fwd: Quick: EU residency adder + baseline hosted pricing — MedTech EU (pricing ask)

Markus / Aditya — forwarding the thread with MedTech Europe. Quick summary and recommended approach:

Summary:
- Prospect expects ~120M tokens/month in year 1 prod. Pilot Q4 at lower volume.
- They flagged preference for EU-only residency (logs + audit trails).
- Procurement asked if we can go to 15% off list for a 36-month commitment.

Recommended commercial response (my proposed offer to Elena):
1) Base list (US) as in the rate card.
2) Residency adder: keep at +10% as standard, but offer effective trade-down if they commit to 36 months at >= $150k/month invoice run-rate:
   - 36-month commit: 18% list discount + reduce residency adder to +5% (effective blended).
   - 12-month commit: 10% list discount, residency adder remains +10%.
3) Additional concessions: 1 month free on 36-month; technical kick-off and 3 enterprise onboarding weeks included.
4) Require a standard data processing addendum and jurisdiction clause to lock regional storage.

Aditya — can you confirm: if we promise EU-only logs and audit trails (for hosted option), are there any platform-level features that will still touch US systems (indexing/telemetry) that would require additional controls? I want a yes/no and a note we can share with legal.

Markus — asking for sign-off to propose the 36-month blended offer (18% list, residency adder -> +5%). If you prefer a different discount ladder, flag now; procurement is pushing 36-months.

Thanks,
Monica

Subject: Final offer: residency-adjusted pricing and 36-month commitment options

Elena / Marco,

Thanks for the fast turnaround. We discussed internally and can propose the following written offer to present to procurement/legal. I’ve attached a one-page summary (Final_Offer_MedTechEU_Q4_2026.pdf) for your packet.

Offer A — 36-month committed (preferred)
- List pricing (US hosted per 1k tokens): Prompt $0.80 / Completion $1.60 / Embeddings $0.45
- Contract discount: 18% off list (applied to all usage)
- Residency adder: +5% on discounted unit price (EU-only storage + regional processing)
- Effective blended per-1k after discounts and adder (example, prompt): $0.656 / 1k tokens
- Onboarding: 3 weeks of enterprise onboarding + technical kick-off included
- Service credit: 1 month free at signing
- SLA: 99.95% monthly availability target for production endpoints, standard credits for miss
- Security: EU-only logs/audit trails guaranteed when residency option checked in contract; AES-256 at rest; TLS in transit; customer KMS available for enterprise plan

Offer B — 12-month committed (faster ramp)
- Contract discount: 10% off list
- Residency adder: +10% on discounted unit price

Notes/terms:
- Dedicated physical isolation (Dedicated product) can be quoted if you require hardware separation — that is a separate procurement path.
- The residency guarantees apply to logs, artifacts, and audit trails marked as EU-scope. Our platform has telemetry that aggregates anonymized operational metrics; that telemetry is not customer-data and may be processed in regional control plane services across our infra footprint. If you need that telemetry restricted we can include contractual restrictions and additional tooling to scrub or route telemetry.

Next steps:
1) If the 36-month offer looks acceptable I’ll send a draft SOW and DPA to legal;
2) If procurement wants a tracked concession (e.g., additional one-time onboarding credits) let me know and I’ll bring it back to Markus for sign-off.

If it helps, I’m available to join procurement/legal at the SOW review — propose Wed 20 Oct at 10am CET.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
